    groups: [hygiene]
  - patterns: [AGENTS.md, yss-project.yaml, ".template-source/process/template-engineering-overview.md"]
    groups: [governance-release]
  - patterns: [skills-lock.json, ".agents/skills/**", ".codex/skills/**", ".cursor/skills/**", ".pi/skills/**", ".template-spec/agents/yss-skill-registry.yaml", ".template-source/agents/skills-maintenance.md", "scripts/*skill*"]
    groups: [skills]

groups:
  cli-sync:
    commands:
      - { run: "node --test submodules/create-yss-spec/tests/sync-fast-smoke.test.js", when: template-source }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-repository-scope-scenarios", when: template-source }
  dedicated-cli-core:
    commands:
      - { run: "node --test .template-source/cli-core/tests/*.test.mjs", when: template-source }
  frontend-delivery:
    commands:
      - run: "scripts/verify-frontend-delivery-scenarios"
        lane: source-scenarios
        parallel_unless_env: [YSS_DEDICATED_INSTANCE_ROOT, YSS_DELIVERY_TEST_BACKEND_ROOT, YSS_DELIVERY_TEST_FRONTEND_ROOT]
      - run: "node .template-source/scripts/verify-delivery-harness-distribution.mjs"
        when: template-source
        lane: generated-distribution
        parallel_unless_env: [YSS_DEDICATED_INSTANCE_ROOT, YSS_DELIVERY_TEST_BACKEND_ROOT, YSS_DELIVERY_TEST_FRONTEND_ROOT]
  strategic-handoff-package:
    commands:
      - { run: "scripts/verify-strategic-handoff-tools-lock", when: template-source }
      - { run: "node --check scripts/lib/strategic-handoff.mjs" }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-strategic-handoff-package-scenarios" }
  design-system:
    commands:
      - { run: "node .template-source/tooling/node/scripts/design-md.mjs lint DESIGN.md", when: template-source }
      - { run: "node .template-source/tooling/node/scripts/design-md.mjs drift", when: template-source }
  hygiene:
    commands:
      - { run: "scripts/verify-governance-layout" }
  tooling:
    commands:
      - { run: ".template-source/scripts/evidence-index --check", when: template-source }
      - { run: "pnpm --dir .template-source/tooling/node test", when: template-source }
      - { run: "pnpm --dir .template-source/tooling/node check:vendor", when: template-source }
  skills:
    commands:
      - { run: "scripts/sync-profile-skills --check --profile=all" , when: template-source }
      - { run: "scripts/sync-skills --check" }
      - { run: "scripts/update-skill-lock --check" }
      - { run: "node --test tests/skill-sync-efficiency.test.mjs", when: template-source }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-skill-registry" }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-skill-governance" }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-upstream-skill-source --source=iloveZzz/yss-harness-design-agent --source-root=submodules/yss-harness-design-agent", when: template-source }
      - { run: "node --test .agents/skills/yss-skill-source-index-refresh/scripts/refresh-yss-skill-index.test.mjs" }
      - { run: "node --test .agents/skills/yss-repository/tests/profile-routing.test.mjs" }
  tactical-design:
    commands:
      - { run: "node .agents/skills/yss-technical-design/scripts/generate-schema.mjs --check" }
      - { run: "node .agents/skills/yss-technical-design/tests/run-scenarios.mjs" }
      - { run: "node --test .agents/skills/yss-technical-design/tests/engineering-scenarios.mjs" }
      - { run: "node --check .agents/skills/yss-tactical-design/scripts/validate-tactical-design.mjs" }
      - { run: "node --check .agents/skills/yss-tactical-design/tests/run-scenarios.mjs" }
      - { run: "node .agents/skills/yss-tactical-design/tests/run-scenarios.mjs" }
  contracts:
    commands:
      - { run: "scripts/verify-yss-dto-openapi-profile" }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-yss-dto-openapi-scenarios" }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-openapi-yaml-first-scenarios" }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-openapi-json-handoff-scenarios" }
  collaboration:

      - { run: "scripts/verify-digital-human-roles" }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-digital-human-roles-scenarios" }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-approval-record --history .template-spec/templates/approval-record-template.yaml" }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-subagent-task-package-scenarios" }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-digital-human-task-package-scenarios" }
      - { run: ".template-source/scripts/verify-historical-task-package .template-source/evidence/maintenance/digital-human-task-package-review-task.yaml", when: template-source }
      - { run: ".template-source/scripts/verify-historical-task-package .template-source/evidence/maintenance/lifecycle-ticket-transition-review-task-package.yaml", when: template-source }
  lifecycle:
    commands:
      - { run: "node --test scripts/fixtures/stage-tracking/tracking.test.mjs", when: template-source }
      - { run: "node --test .template-source/tooling/node/test/decision-continuation.test.mjs", when: template-source }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-user-decision-scenarios" }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-context-contract --root . --json" }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-context-contract-scenarios" }
      - { run: "node scripts/verify-business-language-scenarios" }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-context-reconciliation-scenarios" }
      - { run: "node scripts/verify-script-performance-scenarios" }
      - { run: "scripts/verify-grill-with-docs-context-scenarios" }
